description.narrative: Job Creation and Exports: The Project will generate economy-wide effects including enabling growth in exports and job creation. In addition, jobs along the value chain of the Project Companies will be supported through indirect and induced effects in less developed cities of Turkiye. Reduction in the Carbon Footprint of the Turkish Manufacturing Industry: The Project will support critical exporting sectors for the Turkish economy (textiles and flexible packaging) and help greening of the operations at the Project Companies by enabling them to utilize state-of-art efficient technologies and increase renewable energy in production. Competitiveness: The Project will improve competitiveness of the local textiles, flexible packaging; and cement industries by (i) supporting increased circularity and use of recycled content in production at Sanko Tekstil, (ii) enabling capacity/product portfolio optimization at Super Film to better meet growing demand for more sustainable/environmental products in Europe; and (iii) helping implement a decarbonization strategy to increase use of renewable sources and alternative fuels with improved resource efficiency at Cimko.

The proposed investment consists of a senior, secured debt financing package arranged by IFC for an aggregate amount of up to US$150 million or its EUR equivalent (the IFC Financing) to the following three companies in Turkiye: (i) Sanko Tekstil Isletmeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. (Sanko Tekstil) a vertically integrated premium yarn manufacturer; (ii) Super Film Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. (Super Film) an export-oriented flexible packaging manufacturer; and (iii) Cimko Cimento ve Beton San. Tic. A.S. (Cimko) a leading local cement manufacturer (together, the Project Companies). The IFC Financing will partially finance (i) the construction of a ring spinning mill to be certified as a green building and a recycling facility with roof-top solar panel installations at Sanko Tekstil; (ii) the construction of a greenfield plant to be certified as a green building at Super Film, (iii) several energy efficiency and renewable energy investments at Cimko; and (iv) some earthquake recovery investments by the Project Companies (the Project).

name.narrative: The Project will be implemented in three cities of Turkiye, two of which were hit hard by the two earthquakes in February 2023. Sanko Tekstils and Cimkos investments will be in the epicenters of the earthquakes, Gaziantep and Kahramanmaras, respectively, while Super Films investments will be in Kirklareli in the Marmara Region of Turkiye.
